high_level_description: This image is a satellite view of a hurricane, showcasing the eye of the storm at its center. The eye is a distinct circular area with a dark, almost black core, surrounded by swirling bands of clouds that form the eyewall. These clouds appear to be rotating in a clockwise direction, indicating the storm's rotation. Overlaid on the image is a map outline of an island, which appears to be Cuba, given its shape and location relative to the hurricane. The map is semi-transparent, allowing the hurricane's structure to be visible through it.
